author: Contributor 85
about: Ember Street, a four-person studio, over its first quarter on one Upstash account (journeys/customer-life.outline.md): Priya makes Kiln's Redis database and opens QStash for Looplinks in the console; Kiln's site, its nightly cron and Tomás's scripts use Redis through @upstash/redis and @upstash/ratelimit, sent as those clients send it (auto-pipelined, base64-encoded answers read through the pack's decoded view); Looplinks' app, its workflow routes and Maya's and Sam's scripts use QStash and Workflow (jobs published with delays and labels, cancelled by label, partner onboarding and commission runs of context.run steps read through the steps view, a payout queue upserted with parallelism 1 and deduplicated against a twice-sent cron, the token reset and keys rolled when a contractor leaves, a step failing through its retries into the failure function, payouts failed through a Stripe outage and enqueued again); Looplinks is sold and Kiln leaves Redis on 31 March.

steps.name: so it sends the script itself with EVAL
body:
local currentKey  = KEYS[1]           -- identifier including prefixes
  local previousKey = KEYS[2]           -- key of the previous bucket
  local dynamicLimitKey = KEYS[3]       -- optional: key for dynamic limit in redis
  local tokens      = tonumber(ARGV[1]) -- default tokens per window
  local now         = ARGV[2]           -- current timestamp in milliseconds
  local window      = ARGV[3]           -- interval in milliseconds
  local incrementBy = tonumber(ARGV[4]) -- increment rate per request at a given value, default is 1

  -- Check for dynamic limit
  local effectiveLimit = tokens
  if dynamicLimitKey ~= "" then
    local dynamicLimit = redis.call("GET", dynamicLimitKey)
    if dynamicLimit then
      effectiveLimit = tonumber(dynamicLimit)
    end
  end

  local requestsInCurrentWindow = redis.call("GET", currentKey)
  if requestsInCurrentWindow == false then
    requestsInCurrentWindow = 0
  end

  local requestsInPreviousWindow = redis.call("GET", previousKey)
  if requestsInPreviousWindow == false then
    requestsInPreviousWindow = 0
  end
  local percentageInCurrent = ( now % window ) / window
  -- weighted requests to consider from the previous window
  requestsInPreviousWindow = math.floor(( 1 - percentageInCurrent ) * requestsInPreviousWindow)

  -- Only check limit if not refunding (negative rate)
  if incrementBy > 0 and requestsInPreviousWindow + requestsInCurrentWindow >= effectiveLimit then
    return {-1, effectiveLimit}
  end

  local newValue = redis.call("INCRBY", currentKey, incrementBy)
  if newValue == incrementBy then
    -- The first time this key is set, the value will be equal to incrementBy.
    -- So we only need the expire command once
    redis.call("PEXPIRE", currentKey, window * 2 + 1000) -- Enough time to overlap with a new window + 1 second
  end
  return {effectiveLimit - ( newValue + requestsInPreviousWindow ), effectiveLimit}
